spec.bug: TurnEnded drops blocks before cycleFirst while staying in the current session.
spec.find:
TurnEnded ==
    /\ alive /\ turnOpen /\ live = {}     \* A4
    /\ turnOpen' = FALSE /\ out' = <<>> /\ act' = [name |-> "TurnEnded"]
spec.replace:
TurnEnded ==
    /\ alive /\ turnOpen /\ live = {}     \* A4
    /\ turnOpen' = FALSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> heldFirst, to |-> nextSeq]>> /\ act' = [name |-> "TurnEnded"]

spec.bug: SavedThrough drops held blocks of the active session instead of only SessionCleared dropping departing session blocks.
spec.find: /\ savedThrough' = Min(through, nextSeq) /\ out' = <<>>
spec.replace: /\ savedThrough' = Min(through, nextSeq) /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> heldFirst, to |-> Min(through, nextSeq)]>>

spec.bug: Compacted advances heldFirst to nextSeq so earlier blocks disappear on resize.
spec.find: /\ UNCHANGED <<heldFirst, nextSeq, savedThrough, live, turnOpen, paintedThrough,
spec.replace:
/\ heldFirst' = nextSeq
    /\ UNCHANGED <<nextSeq, savedThrough, live, turnOpen, paintedThrough,

spec.bug: SessionCleared forgets to drop the departing session's held blocks.
spec.find:
/\ out' = IF heldFirst < nextSeq
                 THEN <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> heldFirst, to |-> nextSeq]>>
                 ELSE <<>>
    /\ cycle' = 0

spec.bug: A compaction between turns drops the previous cycle immediately instead of keeping history.
A mid-turn compaction drops the current turn's pre-compaction blocks.
Resized drops blocks before cycleFirst instead of reprinting the entire current session.
spec.find: /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "reprint_begin"]>> /\ act' = [name |-> "Resized"]
spec.replace: /\ out' = (IF heldFirst < cycleFirst THEN <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> heldFirst, to |-> cycleFirst]>> ELSE <<[kind |-> "reprint_begin"]>>) /\ act' = [name |-> "Resized"]

spec.bug: A resize reprints every held block in one slice and freezes the loop.
spec.find:
to |-> Min(paintedThrough + Slice, nextSeq)]>>
               /\ paintedThrough' = Min(paintedThrough + Slice, nextSeq)
spec.replace:
to |-> nextSeq]>>
               /\ paintedThrough' = nextSeq

spec.bug: A block finished during a reprint is painted at once, and the reprint skips the blocks before it.
spec.find:
/\ IF reprinting
          THEN /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED paintedThrough
spec.replace:
/\ IF FALSE
          THEN /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED paintedThrough

spec.find: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "reprint_slice", from |-> paintedThrough,
spec.replace: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "reprint_slice", from |-> IF paintedThrough > heldFirst THEN paintedThrough - 1 ELSE paintedThrough,

spec.find: THEN /\ reprinting' = FALSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_live"]>>
spec.replace: THEN /\ reprinting' = TRUE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_live"]>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, cycleFirst, heldFirst, nextSeq, savedThrough, live, turnOpen, paintedThrough, coOpen, coLo, coHi, coAtStart, pending, pendingDir, nextToken, alive, cycleStarts>>

spec.bug: Opening Ctrl+O reads the log instead of showing the newest blocks from memory.

                 hi |-> nextSeq]>>
spec.replace: /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "read_log", token |-> nextToken, dir |-> "older", from |-> nextSeq, count |-> Step]>>

spec.replace: hi2 == IF pendingDir = "older" THEN coHi ELSE coHi + n

/\ IF coLo > heldFirst
          THEN /\ coLo' = coLo - 1
               /\ coHi' = Min(coHi, coLo - 1 + Window)

               /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, pendingDir, nextToken>>
          ELSE IF Saved
spec.replace:
/\ IF FALSE
          THEN /\ coLo' = coLo - 1
               /\ coHi' = Min(coHi, coLo - 1 + Window)
               /\ coAtStart' = (coLo - 1 = 0)
               /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "ctrlo_show", lo |-> coLo - 1, hi |-> Min(coHi, coLo - 1 + Window)]>>

core.bug: turn_ended drops finished blocks during the active session.
compacted advances held_first so earlier blocks are lost on resize.
session_cleared forgets to emit the drop effect for the departing session.
A block finished during a reprint is painted at once.
A reply is applied without checking its token.
core.find: if (!co.open or co.pending == 0 or co.pending != token) return reject(state, .stale_reply);
core.replace: if (!co.open or co.pending == 0 or (co.pending != token and false)) return reject(state, .stale_reply);

core.bug: Ctrl+O opens on blocks memory no longer holds.
A garbage reply count is trusted.
Resume keeps the dead process's Ctrl+O and live blocks.
An unsaved session reads the log when scrolling older.
core.replace:
if (co.lo > held_first and state.config.saved) return show(state, co.lo - 1, @min(co.hi, co.lo - 1 + window));
            return issueRead(state, .older, co.lo);

core.bug: An empty older reply does not mark the start of the log.
A change to one live block starts a full reprint.
Closing Ctrl+O leaves its read pending.
